# MobjectTable

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.table.MobjectTable`

class MobjectTable(*table*, *element\_to\_mobject=<function MobjectTable.<lambda>>*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table")

    A specialized [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table") mobject for use with [`Mobject`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.html#manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject "manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject").

    Examples

    Example: MobjectTableExample

    ![../_images/MobjectTableExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/MobjectTableExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class MobjectTableExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            cross = VGroup(
                Line(UP + LEFT, DOWN + RIGHT),
                Line(UP + RIGHT, DOWN + LEFT),
            )
            a = Circle().set_color(RED).scale(0.5)
            b = cross.set_color(BLUE).scale(0.5)
            t0 = MobjectTable(
                [[a.copy(),b.copy(),a.copy()],
                [b.copy(),a.copy(),a.copy()],
                [a.copy(),b.copy(),b.copy()]]
            )
            line = Line(
                t0.get_corner(DL), t0.get_corner(UR)
            ).set_color(RED)
            self.add(t0, line)
    ```

    Special case of [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table") with `element_to_mobject` set to an identity function.
    Here, every item in `table` must already be of type [`Mobject`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.html#manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject "manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject").
